name: Kacha
source:
Likes: Sexy Boys

A small elephant like creature with underwear on its head. Considered the mascot of Full Service Spa, it wanders around wherever there are good looking boys. Apparently it can speak...but only to a certain workaholic.

A baby elephant-like creature which hangs around the spa. Thara says he's been around since she was young, and slowly became a pet. No one knows his age or origin, but he's popular with the customers of the spa. Tomoki has the ability to hear what he's trying to say, but to other people it just sounds like his signature growl "KACHA!".
